intro.proseHTML:
What this is

A planned projection from pinned baseline — the PlanGraph build graph exactly as the specification declares it at commit afb23518 — now carrying one lifecycle snapshot: a read-only observation of exec-pm-status.json (sha256 03689288…, updated_at 2026-09-22T03:48:12Z) taken 2026-09-22T03:56:47Z UTC. This page is not live: it does not follow the work; it quotes one status file at one moment. The planned baseline is preserved unchanged underneath, so plan and observed state stay separate dimensions.

How to read the state (lifecycle legend)

INTEGRATED — paper roof, green pip: an explicit acceptance and integration record exists. Only M0, integrated to local main b5dd18b1, not pushed. ACTIVE WORK — blue roof, blue pip: a correction/QA/gate chain is in flight (pg-core). IMPLEMENTED CANDIDATE — blue roof, amber pip: a frozen candidate exists but independent re-verify, GUARD and HOLDOUT are pending (identity-independent-check). The engine owns only four roof colours, so candidate shares the blue roof with active work; the exact text and the amber pip carry the difference. PLANNED — amber roof, hollow pip: no implementation record in the source (the other eight nodes). BLOCKED would be a red roof, UNKNOWN OR STALE an amber roof with an exact stale note; neither appears in this snapshot.

Every state phrase is quoted from the status source and is stale the moment exec-pm-status.json’s sha256 differs from 03689288… or the snapshot is older than 24 h. A hollow pip still marks a declared uncertainty from the plan sources — recorded, not resolved. Every pipe remains the engine’s planned link style; no observed or inferred edge exists in this view. Press Trace to walk the declared critical path; press Stack to lift the graph into its strata.

Deliberately absent

Actual and Compare modes, observed or inferred edges, correspondence, variance disposition, completion percentages, and any live feed. Those are separate slices with their own contracts. This snapshot says what one governance status file said at 03:48Z; it is not a verdict, and an integrated node is not a shipped one.

Sources (read-only, allowlisted, digests in the spec’s provenance block)

01-specification/PRODUCT-PRIMER.md · 03-implementation-plan/module-contracts.json · 03-implementation-plan/build-dag.json · 02-contracts/boundary-ports.json — plus the lifecycle source exec-pm-status.json named above. Two further plan files were excluded by the allowlist and were not read.

nodes.name: STORY-V5-M0-000 · M0 core type surface
nodes.does: The shared type and byte contract every crate compiles against: pg-core M0 newtypes, the port traits, and the common Refusal and Diagnostic shapes. Declared workspace-first; it is the root of the build DAG (depth 0) and touches all three lanes. Consumers are pg-core and identity-independent-check; the independent checker consumes the published contract as a document only and links no pg-core code.
nodes.built: PLANNED. Kind: interface_story, produces_code true. Specification files 02-contracts/m0-types.rs, 02-contracts/port-traits.rs, 02-contracts/rust-record-bindings.json. Binding rule: exact public symbols, visibility, fields, signatures and trait semantics; bodies replace specification placeholders; fixture copies remain byte-exact; amendment required to change the surface.

nodes.name: identity-independent-check
nodes.does: A deliberately separate recomputation of content identity: (DeclaredDomain, RawObject) → Result<RecomputedCid, Refusal>. Its whole purpose is to disagree with pg-core if pg-core is wrong, so it must not share pg-core's code.
nodes.built: PLANNED. Invariant: separate canonicalization and domain concatenation; no dependency on pg-core or its byte helpers; at most 400 source lines. One planned module (identity_independent_check::main). No fixture directories are assigned to this crate in module-contracts. Crate dependencies: none; declared interface dependency on STORY-V5-M0-000.

nodes.name: pg-core
nodes.does: The pure foundation: RawBytes → CanonicalBytes; (Domain, CanonicalBytes) → Cid; SignatureProof → Result<VerifiedSigner, Refusal>. Owns the generated record bindings, the shared port traits, and the AuthorityStore host that issues SnapshotObservations. Every other crate depends on it.
nodes.built: PLANNED. Invariant: no authority mutation or ambient I/O; reject unsafe integers, duplicate raw keys, unregistered domains, unknown fields and mismatched signer/purpose. Five planned modules: raw, canonical, identity, signature, adapters::bip340. Reference adapter for the IdentityVerifier port (pg_core::adapters::bip340, k256 schnorr + sha2). 18 fixture directories assigned under 04-obligations-and-trace/fixtures/. Crate dependencies: none; declared interface dependency on STORY-V5-M0-000.

nodes.name: pg-contract
nodes.does: Closure of typed records into contracts: (TypedRecords, Policy, Registry) → Result<ClosedContractSet, Refusal>. Owns semantic validation of the M0 surface. Selectors stay unbound until dispatch; descriptions never confer authority.
nodes.built: PLANNED. Invariant: all exact references close; selectors remain unbound until dispatch; no authority from descriptions; complete diagnostics. Four planned modules: records, rules, selectors, profiles. 27 fixture directories assigned. Crate dependencies: pg-core.

nodes.name: pg-compile
nodes.does: Turns authoring intent into closed contracts or bounded questions: (AuthoringIntent, Policy, InstitutionGraph) → Closed | Questions | GeneratorDefect. Also the observe path (compile existing work into advisory contracts without gating it) and the v4 migration.
nodes.built: PLANNED. Invariant: deterministic outputs; five-question bound; record every default; observe cannot call mutation ports; migration never invents missing power. Seven planned modules: closure, questions, render, recut, observe, migration/v4.rs, principal_digest. Named reference adapter for the VcsAdapter port: pg_compile::adapters::git (argv-only Git). 40 fixture directories assigned. Crate dependencies: pg-core, pg-contract.

nodes.name: pg-evidence
nodes.does: Captures evidence against an exact frozen candidate: (FrozenCandidate, Instrument, PortCapture) → Result<EvidenceManifest, Refusal>. Hosts the content-addressed blob store with checked retention, the process recorder, and the file-based independent review exchange.
nodes.built: PLANNED. Invariant: exact candidate bytes and provider identity; control ACLs before reads; no producer-authored run or independent verdict accepted as trusted capture. Seven planned modules: capture, review, adapters::directory, adapters::process, adapters::vcs, adapters::exchange, retention. Named reference adapters: BlobStore → pg_evidence::adapters::directory; EvidenceRunner → pg_evidence::adapters::process_recorder; ReviewService → pg_evidence::adapters::review_exchange. Retention contract: denial precedes byte removal; unknown copies and shared-tenant retention prevent false completion. 53 fixture directories assigned. Crate dependencies: pg-core, pg-contract.

nodes.name: pg-ledger
nodes.does: The durable, transactional authority store: (ValidatedDelta, ExpectedVersions) → Result<CommitReceipt, Refusal>. One SQLite database per organization unit; companion writes are atomic; semantic replay returns the original receipt. Also the outbox-driven work exchange and the ancestor delegation feed.
nodes.built: PLANNED. Invariant: all companion writes atomic; semantic replay returns original receipt; unknown remote effects retain holds; recovery epoch invalidates old attempts. Sixteen planned modules including transaction, claims, budgets, outbox, recovery, adapters::sqlite, model, delegation, rates, stewardship, hold, identity_lifecycle, redaction, assistance, exchange, ancestor_feed. Named reference adapters: AuthorityStore → pg_ledger::adapters::sqlite (backend; the host and snapshot issuer live in pg-core); WorkExchange → pg_ledger::adapters::outbox_exchange. 37 fixture directories assigned. Crate dependencies: pg-core, pg-contract.

nodes.name: pg-admit
nodes.does: Admission: (Request, ActorContext, AuthoritySnapshot, TimeObservation) → Result<ValidatedDelta, Refusal>. Checks current authority, fences, revocation, runtime and time in one place; resolves signed ancestor checkpoints and delegation terminals. Hosts the authority clock, runtime attestor, claim authority and effect gateway adapters.
nodes.built: PLANNED. Invariant: no borrowed authority from a board; exact current fences, revocation and runtime; all read versions retained in delta. Seven planned modules: predicates, resolver, adapters::authority_clock, adapters::runtime, control, lineage, ancestor_authority. Named reference adapters: Clock → pg_admit::adapters::authority_clock; RuntimeAttestor → pg_admit::adapters::local_runtime; ClaimAuthority → pg_admit::adapters::local_claim; EffectGateway → pg_admit::adapters::local_gateway. 58 fixture directories assigned. Crate dependencies: pg-contract, pg-core, pg-ledger.

nodes.name: planctl
nodes.does: The command-line face: CliCommand → structured output and exit status. Dispatches verbs to the typed seams of every other crate. The comparator alone owns expected output; verify never closes a status by printing a word.
nodes.built: PLANNED. Invariant: dispatch CLI verbs to typed seams; expected output belongs only to comparator; verify never closes status by printing a word. Three planned modules: main, cli, verify. 11 fixture directories assigned. Crate dependencies: pg-core, pg-contract, pg-compile, pg-admit, pg-ledger, pg-evidence — the deepest crate (depth 5).

nodes.name: STORY-V4-BOOTSTRAP-001 · bootstrap integration
nodes.does: Where all eight crates meet: the integration story that assembles the workspace once every crate story has landed. Produces no code of its own; it consumes one integration_input edge from each crate.
nodes.built: PLANNED. Kind: integration_story, produces_code false, depth 6, lanes A, B, C. Dependencies: pg-core, pg-contract, pg-compile, pg-admit, pg-ledger, pg-evidence, identity-independent-check, planctl.

nodes.name: STAGE-7-EXTERNAL-VERIFICATION
nodes.does: The external release gate. The build DAG states this explicitly: an external release gate, not a fabricated code dependency. It requires the bootstrap integration and nothing else.
nodes.built: PLANNED. Kind: external_gate, produces_code false, depth 7, no lanes. Requires integration STORY-V4-BOOTSTRAP-001.

schema.renames: see lifecycle.mapping.renames — the mapping is authoritative
schema.renderer_contract: Stage C engine: node state is read from lifecycle.nodes and edge state from lifecycle.edges; colour is consistent between node and edge for the same state; every state has a non-colour cue (node pip shape; edge weight step plus junction glyph) and a legend entry; the legend lists every state that can occur; animated traces are labelled explanatory; the runtime telemetry toggle stays present but disabled with a no-fresh-telemetry notice

mapping.text: Status text to states, disclosed: an explicit acceptance-plus-integration record (m0_isolation.state, A/INTEGRATOR delivery) → INTEGRATED; an in-flight correction/QA/gate chain in active_assignments or status → ACTIVE_WORK; a frozen candidate awaiting independent re-verify/GUARD/HOLDOUT → IMPLEMENTED_CANDIDATE; an acceptance record with no integration record → ACCEPTED; a blockers entry against the node → BLOCKED; no record in the source, or a stale source → UNKNOWN_OR_STALE; everything else → PLANNED. ACCEPTED and INTEGRATED are never inferred from file presence, self-report, or absence of telemetry — only from an explicit quoted record. Engine rendering (template unchanged): INTEGRATED → ok roof + shipped pip; ACCEPTED → ok roof + shipped pip; ACTIVE_WORK → build roof + built pip; IMPLEMENTED_CANDIDATE → build roof + amber pip; PLANNED → attn roof + hollow planned pip; BLOCKED → blocked roof + red pip; UNKNOWN_OR_STALE → attn roof + hollow pip with exact stale text. Limitation: four roof colours for seven lifecycle states, so IMPLEMENTED_CANDIDATE shares the blue roof with ACTIVE_WORK and UNKNOWN_OR_STALE would share amber with PLANNED; the exact state text and the inspector pip carry the distinction.
